scope: Read-only source review of AL-S01 leads/funnel backend, public Next.js pages and BFF, consent and attribution handling, finite SMTP outbox command/unit examples, generated contracts, and preservation of AL-S00 boundaries. No stage or production deployment, DB access, or security-setting change was performed.

findings.finding: The form stores one request UUID in sessionStorage and retains it after a successful 202. The backend returns immediately for a previously seen UUID before checking whether the confirmation token expired and needs reissue. Therefore the UI's expired-link recovery instruction cannot produce a fresh message in the same tab. The same retained UUID also causes a different synthetic address entered in that tab to receive 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
findings.recommended_change: Clear/rotate the stored request UUID after a successful acknowledgement, while retaining it across ambiguous network failures; or otherwise bind the client idempotency key to the contact/retry attempt without losing duplicate-submit protection.
findings.evidence_gap: The integration qualification reissues an expired challenge using a newly generated request_id, so it does not exercise the browser's persisted request UUID path.

findings.finding: The client emits event_type=cta.clicked whenever the current route is /join. This records direct visits and page loads as CTA clicks, so the event does not represent the named action.
findings.recommended_change: Emit cta.clicked from the actual CTA click handler, or rename the route event to a page-view event and add a distinct click event only when a CTA is activated.

reviewed_controls.service_bearer_same_origin_host_and_boun: PASS by source inspection; BFF uses a fixed action-to-upstream allowlist, validates Origin and Host, streams with a 2048-byte limit, restricts upstream to loopback HTTP, sends the service bearer server-side, rejects redirects, and filters response keys.
reviewed_controls.closed_synthetic_gate: PASS by source inspection; intake requires dev/stage, enabled flag, CLOSED mode, and exact example.invalid contact domain; non-loopback SMTP is rejected when enabled.
reviewed_controls.request_and_email_idempotency: Backend protections present; browser request UUID lifecycle has the recovery defect above. Email uniqueness and generic acknowledgements are present.
reviewed_controls.confirmation_token: PASS by source inspection; random token hash only, 15-minute expiry, constant-time comparison, one-use clearing, and maximum five failed checks.
reviewed_controls.outbox_and_smtp: PASS by source inspection for bounded behavior; delivery command processes at most 20 rows, has a finite SMTP timeout, logs no message payload, and clears body after SMTP acceptance or token expiry.
reviewed_controls.consent_separation: PASS by source inspection; service consent is required, marketing consent defaults false and is separately stored, and analytics is optional and off by default.
reviewed_controls.attribution_privacy: PASS by source inspection; server maps only three bounded attribution fields to allowlisted constants or OTHER; no referrer or raw query/contact/token is persisted in funnel attribution; nginx example logs URI without query string.
reviewed_controls.account_or_grant_creation: PASS by source inspection; added models and views create leads/funnel events only and do not create accounts, memberships, or access grants.
reviewed_controls.AL_S00_boundary_regressions: No source change observed to identity, marketplace/matrix/processor, or legacy lab services. Probe flag remains restricted to dev/stage; readiness only adds lead/funnel schema checks when intake is enabled.

execution.reason: Requested read-only source review; long tests were intentionally not run while the author continues integration-harness work and Next build.

worktree_note: The worktree contains source changes and ignored .venv/node_modules directories. Keep generated dependencies out of the source commit; no such files were read or edited by this review.
acceptance_boundary: This is SOURCE review only. It does not accept live SMTP, stage/production installation, business migrations on live databases, or public contact collection. Those remain subject to the user's separate live/DB/mail authorization.

resolutions.observed_change: A successful 202 removes alisa-lead-request from sessionStorage. Ambiguous/network failures leave it in place for safe retry; a later submit gets a new request UUID, allowing the same email's expired challenge to be reissued without creating a second lead.

Page events are emitted only for landing and demo routes. cta.clicked is emitted by a document click handler for an actual anchor with href=/join, only while analytics consent is enabled; merely mounting /join emits no CTA event.
